messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created by PagerDuty (high) — continuous-batching throughput spike impacting KV cache and paging. Root cause suspected: recent config push to continuous_batching defaults.
rebecca (oncall): seeing large KV cache growth on eu-west clusters, memory pressure -> paging, tail latency up 3-8x for some tenants. console charts: kv_cache_size per-host trending to 120GB.
matt (eng): which config pushed? I saw a change earlier today to default `max_batch_tokens` and `max_num_seqs` in runtime-config service.
sanjay (runtime): yep, deploy-bot rolled `runtime-config@2026-03-15T09:12Z` with `continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens=65536` and `continuous_batching.max_num_seqs=256` to improve throughput. That explains the blowup.
rebecca (oncall): ok, declare incident. Impact: 12% of requests in prod eu-west seeing >1s additional latency, 3 customers reporting timeouts via support. Customer IDs: cust-421, cust-880, cust-214.
elaine (support): CSMs alerted, drafting a status note. ETA for mitigation?
matt (eng): immediate mitigation plan: (1) roll back to previous runtime-config (max_batch_tokens=8192, max_num_seqs=16), (2) force KV cache eviction for hot keys, (3) set aggressive batching timeout to 25ms while we stabilize.
sanjay (runtime): I can push a hotfix to config-service. Command: ```
# rollback to safe defaults
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://config.redwood/api/v1/patch \
  -d '{"continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens":8192,"continuous_batching.max_num_seqs":16,"continuous_batching.timeout_ms":25}'
```
ops-bot: rolling update started for runtime-config on eu-west pools (batch size=5 hosts at a time).
rebecca (oncall): start throttling heavy tenants as precaution. matt/sanjay, can you add per-tenant token caps?
matt (eng): adding a temporary fetter: per-tenant max_tokens_per_minute for top 5 tenants. Pushing rule now. ```
PATCH /tenant-quota
{"tenant_id":"cust-421","max_tokens_per_minute":20000}
```
sanjay (runtime): evicting KV cache prefixes for streaming sessions older than 5m: `kvcache.evict(prefix='stream:', older_than_ms=300000)` — running on eu-west hosts now. Log tail: ```
[13:04:11] INFO kvcache.size host=euw-12 size=118.3GB
[13:04:23] INFO kvcache.evict host=euw-12 evicted=1.2M keys freed=24.6GB
[13:04:30] WARN paging.swap host=euw-13 rate=40/s
```
rebecca (oncall): noted. ops-bot reports first rollout batch succeeded on 5 hosts, second batch in flight. Any errors?
deploy-bot: host euw-15 failed preflight; auto-rollback to previous runtime on that host. Reason: out-of-disk during cleanup.
matt (eng): ok skip euw-15 and continue. We'll reschedule after disk cleanup.
elaine (support): incoming customer message from cust-880: "api returning 504 on embeddings, started ~12:50 UTC" — flagged as high. Sending interim workaround: retry/backoff guidance.
rebecca (oncall): assign incident lead to matt. I'm handing to matt for the next 60m. Handoff note: tracking mitigation tasks, CSM comms, and next steps.
matt (eng): taking lead. Action items: 1) complete config rollback across eu-west (target +20m), 2) validate tail latency metrics and SLA gates, 3) ETA to fully drain paging/backpressure.
sanjay (runtime): rollback done on remaining eu-west hosts. KV cache size trending down to ~18GB avg. Latency real-time panel shows p50 returned to baseline, p95 improving.
matt (eng): I'm opening a canary to validate with cust-214 traffic only for 10m.
ops-bot: canary started, route=canary-cust-214, 1000 reqs/min.
rebecca (oncall): good. Are there any related config changes in the pipeline?
matt (eng): paused all runtime-config merges. We will require a safety check for any change to `continuous_batching.*` and an automatic canary gate. New PR template and CLI guard in review.
elaine (support): CSMs sent a brief status update to affected customers: "We observed an operational regression after a configuration change to continuous batching. We rolled back to safe defaults and are monitoring. We will follow up with a full RCA."
pagerduty-bot: Incident escalated to Sev2 -> On-call handoff recorded.
matt (eng): monitoring shows residual paging IO on hosts that hit swap earlier; working with SRE to throttle background jobs and repin processes off thrashing disks.
sanjay (runtime): propose long-term guardrails: reject any `max_batch_tokens` > 16384 without staged canary, and auto-enforce `max_num_seqs` <= 64 per host unless quota-approved. Will draft RFC.
matt (eng): agree. Also add metrics: `kvcache.size_per_tenant`, `continuous_batching.inflight_seq_count` to Console.
rebecca (oncall): final note before I go offline: incident declared, mitigation complete for now, but continue monitoring for 2 hours. I put "incident/cont-batch-kvcache" in statusboard. If latency rises >25% again, page SRE.
matt (eng): closing actions: schedule postmortem, tag commits, and coordinate customer follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident transitioned to monitoring. Incident state: mitigated.
